landing.hero: Understand how you respond to volatility — and grow calmer over time.
landing.heroDesc: Holzen isn't a trading tool. It's a self-awareness practice. When Bitcoin moves, you get a moment to pause, reflect, and notice your patterns — before you act on impulse.

steps.01desc: Holzen watches daily and 7-day cumulative volatility against your personal thresholds. Or request a reflection anytime you need one.
steps.02desc: A breathing exercise grounds you. A quick mood check captures how you feel right now — anxious, neutral, or calm.
steps.03desc: An AI-generated reflection encourages awareness, not action. Accompanied by a haiku and a historical insight for perspective.
steps.04desc: Tag your emotions. Journal a note. Record what you did — held, sold, bought, or nothing. Over time, patterns emerge.

landing.scienceQuote: Impulsive decisions under volatility consistently lead to worse outcomes.
landing.scienceDesc: Behavioral finance research shows that emotional reactions — panic selling during drops, euphoric buying during surges — are among the most reliable predictors of poor returns. A brief pause before action leads to better decisions.
landing.pricingDesc: Your first 3 reflections are free — no card required. Then $3/month for unlimited reflections, companions, mood tracking, and insights. Cancel anytime.
landing.clarityWorth: How much is one moment of clarity worth?

faq.whatAnswer: Holzen monitors Bitcoin volatility across two windows — 24-hour and 7-day cumulative. When movement crosses your thresholds, it offers an AI-generated reflection, a breathing exercise, a haiku, and a historical insight. You can also request reflections on demand. Over time, you track your moods, tag your emotions, journal notes, and see how your composure evolves.
faq.adviceQuestion: Will it tell me what to buy or sell?
faq.adviceAnswer: Never. Holzen is not a trading tool or financial advisor. Reflections are intentionally neutral — they exist only to create a moment of awareness before you act on impulse.
faq.trackingQuestion: How does mood and outcome tracking work?
faq.trackingAnswer: Before each reflection, you do a quick 1-tap mood check (anxious, neutral, calm). After dismissing a reflection, you record what you did — held, sold, bought, or nothing. Your insights panel shows these patterns over time, helping you see how your emotional responses and decisions evolve.
faq.cumulativeAnswer: Beyond daily swings, Holzen tracks the rolling 7-day price movement. A slow-burn 12% drop over a week might never trigger a 5% daily threshold — but it matters. You set both thresholds independently.
faq.dataAnswer: Only what's needed: your email, thresholds, reflections, mood entries, and push tokens if enabled. You can export all your data anytime or delete your account entirely.
faq.cancelAnswer: Yes. Cancel through the app whenever you like — you keep access until the end of your billing period. No contracts, no commitments.

landing.footer: Holzen is not a trading tool. It won't tell you what to do. It exists to help you understand yourself — one volatile moment at a time.
